draft.subject: our founding-client rate
draft.body:
Hi Sian,

Our founding-client rate of £3,000 ends on Friday 27 November, so I'd need to hear back from you by then to hold it for Hale Morrow.

Should I close the loop?

earlier_steps.subject: your merger with Pembury
earlier_steps.body:
Hi Sian,

Saw Hale Morrow has merged with Pembury & Co, bringing the team to 31 lawyers. Merging two firms' client files usually raises questions about where that data can go.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is this on your radar?
